provenance.inputs_summary: stored Aspen Plus V15 cracked gas; reduced-order purification models; Phase 2 unified reference scenario (data/reference_scenario.yaml) for every cost input

iso_14687.source: ISO 14687:2019 Hydrogen fuel quality - Product specification, first edition 2019-11; Table 2 (grade D), Table 3 (grade E), Table 4 (grades A-C); text read from https://consultations.standards.govt.nz/draft-standards/hydrogen-standards-pc/user_uploads/dz-14687.pdf, accessed 2026-11-23

D.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I/II grade D (PEM fuel cell road vehicles)

E3.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade E category 3 (PEM stationary, gaseous hydrogen)

other.water: non-condensing at any ambient conditions (site specific, not evaluated)

B.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade B (Table 4, applications other than PEM fuel cells), used here as the industrial 99.9 % hydrogen specification

other.note: Only the hydrogen fuel index (99.90 %) and total gases (1000 umol/mol) are used. Per-species rows of Table 4 (N2 400, O2 100, total hydrocarbons 100 umol/mol and others) are printed in a column layout that the text extraction could not assign to a grade with certainty, so they are NOT applied and are listed as not evaluated.

A.name: ISO 14687:2019 Type I grade A (Table 4, gaseous hydrogen for combustion engines and other non-PEM uses)

other.note: Combined water, oxygen, nitrogen and argon at most 1.9 % (19 000 umol/mol) per Table 4 footnote b; other rows not applied.

ranking_usd_per_kg_usable_h2.conditional_on: CONDITIONAL on ideal H2/N2 selectivity >= 12919 (N2 300 ppm); the base model assumes infinite selectivity. Sourced value (Phase 2): Cechetto et al. 2021 state ideal H2/N2 above 400,000 (double sealed) and above 500,000 (dead end) at 450 degC; the printed double-sealed N2 permeance (3.7e-11) gives only about 40,500, so the sourced range is 40,500 to 500,000. Caveats: ideal (single gas), new membrane, one group, 450 degC, trace NH3 only; mixed-gas and aged values not found

config_labels.PSA_CHO: TSA + PSA, published point (R 0.756 at 99.11 %, Cho 2026)
config_labels.PSA_B_MB: TSA + PSA at 99.910 %, recovery from mass-balance relation (tail H2 fraction 0.417 held from Cho point; optimistic)
config_labels.PSA_B_LOW: TSA + PSA at 99.910 %, recovery 0.71 (lowest published point, Hansen/Cha 2021)
config_labels.PSA_D_MB: TSA + PSA at 99.975 %, recovery from mass-balance relation (tail H2 fraction 0.417 held from Cho point; optimistic)
config_labels.PSA_D_LOW: TSA + PSA at 99.975 %, recovery 0.71 (lowest published point, Hansen/Cha 2021)
config_labels.PSA_AMCRAX: AmCraX baseline splitter (R 0.85, N2 slip 0.001; Aspen assumption F4)
config_labels.MEM_1bar_polish: Pd-Ag membrane R 0.90, permeate 1 bar + NH3 polishing bed
config_labels.MEM_vac0.1bar_polish: Pd-Ag membrane R 0.90, permeate 0.1 bar + NH3 polishing bed
